name: Campingplatz Seewang
beschreibung:
Campingplatz Seewang is conveniently yet peacefully situated close to pristine waters and striking alpine summits. Guests enjoy sunny pitches, modern sanitary facilities, and attentive personal service.

The surrounding region provides wonderful excursion opportunities to Ehrenberg Castle, famous royal palaces, and the scenic valleys of the Tyrolean Ausserfern.
kurzbeschreibung: Campingplatz Seewang in the Ausserfern region impresses with lakeside proximity, mountain views, and direct trail access.
